strings.string: Optional name shown to recipients. Every beta notification remains clearly marked TESTNOTRUF and KEIN ECHTER NOTFALL. The name syncs through Garmin services, is stored on the watch, and is visible to configured providers.

Optional details shown only inside the opened Grafana alert, not in the short lock-screen push. All entries sync through Garmin services, are stored on the watch, and are sent unencrypted to Grafana. Leave fields blank when unnecessary.
Address and apartment or access details
Names, ages, dependencies, pickup or care information
Who to contact and what to do first
Publicly reachable https:// image URL; Grafana and the image host can see access
Optional fallback TEST delivery. After acceptance, real GPS is shared with Pushover and Google Maps for up to one hour. Settings sync through Garmin services and are stored on the watch.
30 characters from the receiving Pushover account

Formatted-webhook TEST delivery. Receiver setup can add Important Push and in-app acknowledgement. Alert text and GPS links are visible to Grafana. The secret URL syncs through Garmin services and is stored on the watch.
